registered_note: Registered before any E4 evaluation. Smoke runs (first pair of each method) check only the validity flags and the loader, not the contrasts; they stay in the batch.
question: Experiment 1 measured each method's component on/off contrast with kinematic metrics only. Does the physical-feasibility criterion (external force the motion needs but the feet cannot supply) move with the same components, and how do the eight methods compare on it
criterion: E criterion of the report: residual force = required external force of the whole body minus the best ground reaction force the active foot contacts can supply under friction, as a fraction of body weight
data: Existing experiment-1 outputs, read only; no new generation. Runs from develop_logs/test_runs/20261024_native_matrix_analysis/analysis.json (paused clock) and Kimodo pairs from develop_logs/test_runs/20261024_kimodo_pair_audit/audit.json

selection.rule: Per method and task, the two lowest seeds present in every listed condition. Kimodo: the first case (by case path) of each of the 26 constraint families, raw and corrected outputs
selection.convention: Two seeds per task: convention to fit about 480 OpenSim runs into the CPU share left by E3 (4 workers), not derived

kimodo.cluster: constraint type (family without the notext / withtext prefix), 13 clusters

pipeline.same_as: config/e1_biomech_20261101.json pipeline (Rajagopal model, joint-centre markers, per-segment scaling, IK, required wrench, friction-cone ground reaction estimate, inverse dynamics, static optimization), with the global heading unclamped (free_yaw) for every run as in E1Y
pipeline.loader: utils/motiogen/biomech_sources.py: canonical Z-up joints for all methods except Kimodo (native Y-up SOMA77 posed_joints, 30 fps, rotated to Z-up); spine1 / spine3 renamed to the axial-marker sources Spine / Spine3; CHOIS body wrists used as wrist centres

validity.gates: As E1: IK marker RMS <= 0.03 m, IK max <= 0.10 m, mean required vertical force within 2% of body weight
validity.primary_set: Pairs whose two runs both pass; the all-pairs result is reported as sensitivity
validity.report: Pass fractions per method and condition are reported before any contrast

statistics.effect: Paired difference on minus off within (task, seed), mean over seeds, equal task weight
statistics.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over task clusters (Kimodo: constraint-type clusters), 10000 resamples, seed 20261103
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the eight primary contrasts (the first contrast of each method) on residual_force_rms_bw; other contrasts and metrics descriptive
statistics.levels: Per method and condition: median and interquartile range of residual_force_rms_bw over runs, the cross-method table of the report

hypotheses.H1: Output-layer correction raises the residual force: ARDY correction (history_long 0) and Kimodo correction, on minus off > 0
hypotheses.H2: OmniControl spatial guidance (realism on) raises the residual force, on minus off > 0
hypotheses.H3: MotionLCM control residual, CHOIS guidance, DART goal update, PRIMAL inertialization: two-sided, no direction registered
hypotheses.H4: Positive control: CLoSD motions are executed in a physics simulator, so their residual-force median is below that of every kinematic method in both conditions

contact_validation.purpose: CLoSD stores the simulator contact forces per body. The estimated vertical ground reaction force should follow them
contact_validation.measure: Pearson r between the estimated total vertical ground reaction force and the simulator total vertical contact force, both divided by their own clip mean, on the trimmed common time grid; flight fractions of both
contact_validation.threshold: Median r >= 0.8 across CLoSD runs: convention, not derived

boundaries: CHOIS motions carry or push objects whose hand loads are not modelled; CHOIS residual force includes the missing object interaction, so CHOIS levels are not compared with other methods, only its own contrast
Methods differ in clip length (3 to 20 s), frame rate (20 / 30 fps) and task; levels across methods describe each method's own task set, not a matched benchmark
Joint-centre markers only: no orientation of hands, feet or head; same as E1
